Key Features of ENGWE Y400 Adult Moped
1. 750W hub motor & 3 speed modes
2. C-Shaped & rear suspensions
3. 499Wh battery & 25-mile range
4. Foldable design & 10*2.5-inch all-terrain fat tires
5. 15° max slope, dual disc brakes & lighting system
Learn About ENGWE Y400 Motorized Scooter for Adults
The ENGWE Y400 is the best electric moped for adults, combining the convenience of a foldable electric scooter with the power of an electric scooter bike. Designed for both urban commuting and rugged terrain, this off-road electric scooter features a robust 750W motor, C-shaped and rear shocks for superior comfort, and a top speed of 23MPH. Its lightweight yet durable frame makes it an electric standing scooter and kick scooter hybrid, offering flexibility and portability. With a range of up to 25 miles, it's perfect for daily commutes or adventurous rides. As a street-legal scooter, the ENGWE Y400 ensures safety and compliance while delivering a smooth and efficient ride. Whether you're navigating city streets or exploring off-road paths, this innovative scooter adapts to your lifestyle seamlessly.
ENGWE Y400 Spec
1. Matertial: Aluminum Alloy
2. Motor: 500W rated, 750W peak
3. Speed: 23 MPH
4. Climbing Grade: 15°
5. Tire: 10×2.5 inches
6. Battery: 499Wh (48V 10.4Ah) lithium battery
7. Maximum Range: 25 Miles
8. Charging Time: 6 H
9. Brake System: Front and rear disc brakes
10. Product Weight: 23 lbs
11. Maximum Load: 120 kg (264.55 lbs)
12. Display: LCD display
